appDescription: Review local driving habits and request driver confirmation for changes.

function.name: GET_DRIVING_SUMMARY
function.description: Return numeric driving habits for today or the current week.

period.description: The period covered by the driving summary.

function.name: GET_PROMISE_STATUS
function.description: Return numeric counts for the selected weekly driving promises.

function.name: GET_CHANGE_STATUS
function.description: Return comparison readiness and remaining weeks or months.

function.name: MARK_OTHER_DRIVER
function.description: Ask the driver to confirm a driver correction on the parked screen.

function.name: PAUSE_FAMILY_SHARING
function.description: Ask the driver to confirm pausing family sharing on the parked screen.
